name: Waseej
summary:
Waseej is the home of Ana Al Madinah VR's cinematic documentaries: immersive films about Islamic heritage, filmed in 8K and made for VR.

NOW SHOWING
• The Hajj series — follow each of the three ways of performing Hajj from beginning to end:
 – Mutamatti' (Hajj al-Tamattu')
 – Qarin (Hajj al-Qiran)
 – Mufrid (Hajj al-Ifrad)

COMING SOON
• The Story of the Kaaba
• Hijrat al-Rasul — the Prophet's (peace be upon him) migration to Madinah

HOW VIEWING WORKS
